name: Mitsubishi A6M2 Model 21 Zero
blurb: The game's A6M2 Model 21, built in Blender from cited dimensions and a measured real-airplane three-view, with moving gear, propeller and control surfaces.
history:
The Mitsubishi A6M2 Model 21 was the carrier-capable Zero that fought through the opening Pacific campaigns. Its low weight, broad wing and long range made it formidable at low and moderate speeds, while the absence of armor and self-sealing tanks left it vulnerable.

What this entry models: an original Blender A6M2 with a 39 ft 4 in span, 29 ft 9 in length, three-bladed propeller and the real cockpit measured from the Wikimedia Commons three-view. It is the model used in flight; the retired download remains in the DEV Hangar.
